name: canon-recall
description: LIVE: this suite asks the production store, not the fixture corpus (no throwaway database). Forty-five concepts — the twenty-five of the Canon (haskell-kb/notes/concepts) and the twenty of the Theory (theory-kb/notes/category-theory) — each asked once, in English. The concept's own note must show up in the top 5; recall@1 and MRR say how often it comes FIRST. Born 26/11 with the English-corpus law: a question in another language reaches the store only through its English restatement, so what the suite asks is what the boundary finally searches, and what it answers is whether a curated note outranks the fragments of the manuals it cites. The twins in the other language this suite used to carry were retired on 26/11: a translated twin duplicates its English case.
